replication_native_redemptions.limitation: the extract omits transaction hash, trader, denoms, and action fields; direction is traced via package code
replication_native_redemptions.normalization_evidence: Replication figure multiplies swap_amount by LUNA USD price and divides by 1e6 to plot USD millions; its fee percentage is fee/(fee+swap), confirming token-unit LUNA outputs.

terra_core_evidence.logic: burn offerCoin; mint swapCoin.Add(feeCoin); send swapCoin to recipient; send feeCoin to oracle module

units.fee_amount: LUNA token units minted and sent to the oracle module, normalized from uluna
units.offer_amount: UST token units, normalized from uusd before this extract
units.swap_amount: LUNA token units delivered to the recipient, normalized from uluna
